changes_made.explanation: This paper focuses on constituent parsing, which is a natural language understanding (NLU) task, not natural language generation (NLG). The sequence-to-sequence model is used to generate parsing actions/structures, not natural language text. Therefore, this paper does not address NLG tasks.

The F1, Precision, and Recall metrics mentioned are used to evaluate parsing accuracy (syntactic analysis), not to evaluate generated natural language text. Since this is not an NLG paper, these are not NLG evaluation metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges in this parsing paper.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper is about constituent parsing using sequence-to-sequence models, which is a natural language understanding (NLU) task, not natural language generation (NLG). While it uses sequence-to-sequence architectures, the generated outputs are parsing structures/actions, not natural language text. Therefore, it does not belong to the NLG evaluation category.
